scope: Authorized introduction fee, explicit voice preview and outgoing pending CTA change

source.confirmation_source: Voice confirmation sheet, decoded HTML 4597-4627; text variant reuses its layout under user authorization

approved_overrides: 2026-10-20 user authorized replacing text-free with 10 coins per newly sent text introduction; voice remains 10 coins
Text CTA: Send text introduction · 10 Coins; shared confirmation/insufficient/processing/failure flow
Voice recording CTA: Review voice introduction → separate Voice preview → fee confirmation → send
Discover deck and profile outgoing pending CTA: grey/inert Waiting for reply; canonical Home request remains accessible
No retroactive billing or rewriting historical free requests; no automatic acceptance, fake delivery or purchase success

entities.introduction_draft: Existing owned introduction draft; question_id, text/mode/audio_id, stable operation_id and completed_request_id. A completed draft routes refresh to its canonical sent request.
entities.coin_spend: Existing owned coin_spend draft; kind now includes text_introduction; payload holds introduction_draft_id, user_id, question_id, confirmed text or audio snapshot and stable operation_id.
entities.request_and_ledger: One pending request + one -10 completed transaction committed atomically. business_key text:<request_id> or voice:<request_id>. Retry receipts return the original request without mutation.
entities.primary: Read-only introduction_context primary.disabled derives from current outgoing pending request, not component-local state. Connected Chat and incoming View request remain enabled.
entities.migration: Additive payload/derived fields only; existing entity/storage schema remains readable. No new seed credit and no migration debit. Historical free request/receipt/ledger retained unchanged.
